method: Whole-file manual reading of German catalog; pinned bytes reverified and v91 structural comparison retained.
findings: Vermutliche Duplikate, Hash-Präfix and Stichproben-Hash retain distinct confidence/hash representations; sampling option explicitly specifies files over64MiB. No proof of full equality inferred from sampled hashes.
Recovery distinguishes Wiederherstellbar from Möglicherweise wiederherstellbar and requests Dateidaten prüfen after restoration. Same-source-volume warning explains overwrite risk.

Recovery metadata-changed message says Quelldaten geändert rather than explicitly metadata; Junctions is generic Verknüpfungen whereas symbolic links and hardlinks have distinct labels. These wording limitations can blur source-specific distinctions.
Sparsify is Datei ausdünnen, distinct from Komprimieren; glob and regex remain distinguished. Logical/physical size labels and binary-unit labels are explicit.
Ctrl display is localized to Strg in custom cleanup shortcut format while both brace fields remain intact. This does not verify actual accelerator routing or mnemonic uniqueness.
Delete irreversible wording denotes the permanent-delete path, not tested secure erasure. MSI de-DE/1031/1252 values are declarations only.
limits: No rendered German interface, Windows installer encoding, keyboard navigation or runtime validation. No foreign production code adopted.
Native pHash investigation deferred; completed repository count remains147/500.
